capabilities: Read, edit, move, and organize notes
extras: Requires external setup for local models (Ollama, LM Studio) or API keys for cloud providers. API keys are stored in .obsidian/plugins/engram-chat/data.json.
problem: Standard AI interactions lack persistent memory of user facts and cannot intelligently interact with the contents of a local knowledge base like a vault.
summary: Engram Chat is an AI sidebar that provides persistent memory, semantic vault search, and full read/write access to notes using multiple AI providers.
